triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var defender = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!defender) return false; if (!ctx.targetPiece || ctx.targetPiece.instanceId !== defender.instanceId) return false; return !!(defender.statusTags && defender.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'icebound-fortitude'; })); }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var defender = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!defender) return { success: false }; var hasIcebound = defender.statusTags && defender.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'icebound-fortitude'; }); if (!hasIcebound) return { success: false }; ctx.damage = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ctx.damage * 0.5)); var attacker = ctx.sourcePiece; var msg = defender.name + '的寒冰坚忍生效！伤害降低50%'; if (attacker && attacker.currentHp > 0) { var alreadyFrozen = attacker.statusTags && attacker.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'freeze'; }); if (!alreadyFrozen) { addStatusEffectById(attacker.instanceId, { id: 'icebound-freeze-' + attacker.instanceId, name: '冰冻', type: 'freeze', currentDuration: 1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1 }); applyEffect(attacker.instanceId, 'effect-freeze'); msg += '，' + attacker.name + '被冰冻1回合'; if (!battle.actions) battle.actions = []; battle.actions.push({ type: 'triggerEffect', playerId: defender.ownerPlayerId, turn: battle.turn.turnNumber, payload: { message: '❄️ ' + attacker.name + '攻击了' + defender.name + '，被寒冰坚忍反冻！（冰冻1回合，无法行动）' } }); } } return { success: true, message: msg }; }
